entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance.
Thanks for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I need to return. I know I'm probably outside the return window, but we had a major family emergency.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It’s a preference, really. It was a gift for my son, but his military deployment got moved up unexpectedly. Between that and my husband having to go to the hospital for emergency surgery, the last month has been a blur and I completely missed the deadline to send it back.
I certainly understand that life gets in the way. I hope everyone is doing better now. Let me pull up your order and check our policy to see what we can do. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88675. Look, I know policy is policy, but if a full refund is impossible, would you consider a partial store credit? I'd be happy to negotiate something.
Thank you for that. Let me see... I have the order here, delivered 43 days ago. And... actually, it looks like you don't have to worry. You are well within the return period.
You're kidding? I was sure I read it was only a few weeks. Are you positive?

I am. I'm looking at our official policy for this product right now, and it states a 10-day return window for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. So we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you, no exception needed.
Oh, wow. That's fantastic! I was all prepared to bargain for a discount code or something. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Alex.

You are very welcome. I'm happy it was a simple resolution for you. I've just initiated that return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. I really appreciate your help today.
My pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
